name: Anki MCP
tagline: Create and review Anki flashcards from your AI agent.
shortDescription: An MCP server for Anki. Add cards, search your deck, generate cards from text, and trigger review sessions. The fastest way to turn what you learn into long-term memory.
longDescription:
## What it is

A community MCP server for Anki. Connects to AnkiConnect (the Anki plugin) and exposes card operations: add cards, search your deck, get due cards, generate cards from text, and trigger reviews.

## Why we recommend it

Spaced repetition is the most evidence-backed learning technique. The MCP server lets your agent turn any text into a deck — perfect for technical docs, vocabulary, or interview prep.

## When to use it

- Doc-to-deck: agent reads a doc and generates cloze-deletion cards
- Vocabulary: agent turns a glossary into bidirectional cards
- Interview prep: agent generates 'explain X in your own words' cards
- Bulk import: agent takes a CSV and creates hundreds of cards in one call
installInstructions:
1. Install Anki desktop from https://apps.ankiweb.net
2. Install the AnkiConnect add-on (code: 2055492159)
3. Make sure Anki is running
4. `uvx anki-mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Anki is free. AnkiMobile (iOS) is a one-time $25.
